evidence.description: Confirmed the defensive `unset ANICCA_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY` fires before any wallet derivation; the identity-match guard derives OWN_WALLET (this instance's ANICCA_HOME) and CLI_WALLET (forced ANICCA_HOME=$HOME/.blockrun) via the SAME unmodified runtime/wallet-address-solana.mjs and HALTs (exit 0, trace-only, zero new ledger lines) unless both are non-empty and equal, BEFORE the cumulative earn-guard.mjs check and BEFORE franklin-trading start -- matches REQ-002's EARS ordering exactly. Money-safety check (i) no cross-instance key fallback: CONFIRMED at the code level.

Confirmed `unset ANICCA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY` fires before `resolve-identity.mjs evm`, and the resolved SIGNKEY is re-exported under $PKVAR (default BLOCKRUN_WALLET_KEY), overwriting whatever was sourced from $HOME/.openclaw/.env earlier in the same script -- the ambient automaton key can never survive to any downstream child. Empty SIGNKEY HALTs (exit 0) at line 50-53, before the P1 earn-guard.mjs call even runs.

resolveEvmPrivateKey/resolveSolanaSecret both fail-closed to null on any unresolvable/malformed input, both gate the legacy shared-home fallback to ONLY the rightful owner's effectiveHome (never merge across instances), matching REQ-001/REQ-002's EARS text verbatim.
Money-safety check (ii) spend cap: `MAX_SPEND="${SOL_TRADE_MAX_SPEND:-0.25}"` passed to `franklin-trading start ... --max-spend "$MAX_SPEND"` (line 65) -- confirmed present and wired through.

Money-safety check (iii) win/loss both recorded: `earn_usdc = delta>0?delta:0; cost_usdc = delta<0?-delta:0` -- both branches call record() unconditionally (no delta>0 gate, the ONE deliberate divergence from record-payout.mjs). Corroborated by a REAL on-chain artifact: verification/security-results/realchain-e2e.log shows a genuine recorded LOSS (net_usdc:-0.008664) against a real signature from Franklin's own wallet 8Fpqd..., proving the win/loss-symmetric recording is not merely unit-tested but exercised against live chain data.

Money-safety check (iv) external:true only on cash-settled receipts: record-swap.mjs's JSON payload NEVER includes an `external` key (comment explicitly documents why); ledger.mjs's deriveLine only sets `line.external=true` when `o.external===true`, and isProfitable() requires `line.external===true` to return true -- a sol-trade line can never claim GATE-0. Cross-checked against earn/run.sh's OWN external:true usage (line 146), which sets it ONLY after `isExternalPayout()` asserts an inbound transfer from an approved external payer (0xwork taskPool) -- the only other place in the touched files that sets external:true, and it is gated correctly.
